what.text: This page follows refugees from Burundi living in Belgium, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4219 Burundian refugees in Belgium, 1.3% of all refugees from Burundi.
Tanzania hosts the most Burundian refugees, followed by Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in periods from 1991 to 2024, most recently with RED-TABARA.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2021 to 2025, overlap the 2019 to 2024 period of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 472 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belgium.
These are year-end totals for Belgium only, reported to UNHCR.
